critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 1070 lines includes duplicated demo-seed logic in /api/seed (auto-seed on registration) AND now seed_db.py CLI (near-identical). Consider extracting seed_data() into a shared module (backend/seed_common.py) that both server.py and seed_db.py import, so demo data drift stays impossible.

/api/seed uses fixed date strings ('2026-07-15', '2026-06-18', etc.) while seed_db.py uses relative today+/-N days — a user auto-seeded via FE gets stale hard-coded dates, while CLI-seeded demo gets fresh dates. Unify to relative dates in both.

seed_db.py imports models directly from server (`from server import ...`), which triggers server.py module init (routes registration, mongo client, etc.) as a side-effect. Consider splitting models into backend/models.py to keep CLI startup lean.
docs/INSTALLATION.md + docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md + README.md + backend/.env.example + frontend/.env.example: present and readable (spot-checked). No issue.
GET /api/ root endpoint returned successfully as required.

Endpoint names to remember: quote→job is POST /api/quotes/{id}/job (not /to-job); job→invoice is POST /api/jobs/{id}/invoice; reports is GET /api/reports (not /reports/summary). /api/seed is auto-called by FE after registration and idempotently populates 3 customers/4 jobs/2 quotes/2 invoices/3 worklogs/3 docs/3 payments into the NEW user's account – this is intentional onboarding, not a data-leak; the demo account's rows remain isolated by user_id (verified). seed_db.py CLI is separate and only touches the DEMO account by default. The FE-side dashboard for a freshly-registered user will show 3 customers etc. because /api/seed ran – do not report as data isolation bug.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. During UI testing a fresh registered user's Dashboard appeared to show demo data (3 customers, 1 209 999 Ft revenue, Kovács/Nagy jobs). Initial suspicion of data-leak was ruled out by (a) direct API call confirming a freshly-registered user starts with customers=0 before any /api/seed call, (b) observed network trace showing FE calls POST /api/seed immediately after /api/auth/register which is the intentional onboarding auto-seed (server.py:971 – guarded by users.seeded flag, idempotent), and (c) pytest test_isolation_from_demo confirming distinct customer IDs between demo and new users. Behavior is by design and matches the review request wording ('a demo fiókkal ... belépve a Dashboard 3 ügyfelet ... mutat').
